# Son-Vidéo.com

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

French online retailer of hi-fi, home cinema, speakers, televisions, projectors, headphones, vinyl, cables and connected-home products. Its delivery FAQ says it delivers across French territory including most DOM-TOM products, with free delivery to its shops in France.

*ES:* Tienda online francesa de alta fidelidad, cine en casa, altavoces, televisores, proyectores, auriculares, vinilos, cables y productos para el hogar conectado. Su FAQ de entrega indica que entrega en todo el territorio francés, incluidos la mayoría de los productos en los DOM-TOM, y que la entrega en sus tiendas de Francia es gratuita.

## Shopping notes

Delivery FAQ also says it ships across Europe and to Switzerland, and outside Europe on request. Chronopost on appointment and Mondial Relay exclude Corsica.
